name: Equations and Inequalities
description: Solve equations by keeping both sides in balance, then use them to find unknown prices.

lessonNames.l9-story-to-equation: Turning a story into an equation
lessonNames.l11-one-twist: Solving like an equation, with one twist
lessonNames.l15-swapping-in: Swapping one letter for an expression

lessonObjectives.l1-letters-for-numbers: Write an expression for a quantity described in words.
lessonObjectives.l2-like-terms: Simplify an expression by grouping terms of the same kind.
lessonObjectives.l3-opening-brackets: Expand a single bracket with an area model, including negative terms.
lessonObjectives.l4-putting-brackets-back: Factorise an expression by taking out the highest common factor.
lessonObjectives.l5-keeping-the-balance: Solve one-step equations by doing the same thing to both sides.
lessonObjectives.l6-undoing-in-reverse: Solve two-step equations by undoing the last operation first.
lessonObjectives.l7-unknowns-both-sides: Gather the unknown on one side before solving.
lessonObjectives.l8-clearing-fractions: Multiply through by a common denominator to solve an equation with fractions.
lessonObjectives.l9-story-to-equation: Form an equation from a worded problem, solve it and check the answer makes sense.
lessonObjectives.l10-ranges-of-answers: Show an inequality on a number line with open and closed ends.
lessonObjectives.l11-one-twist: Solve linear inequalities and reverse the sign when multiplying by a negative.
lessonObjectives.l12-trapped: Solve a double inequality and list the integers that satisfy it.
lessonObjectives.l13-changing-the-subject: Rearrange a formula to make a different letter the subject.
lessonObjectives.l14-two-clues: Solve simultaneous equations by adding or subtracting them to remove one letter.
lessonObjectives.l15-swapping-in: Solve simultaneous equations by substitution, including one linear and one quadratic.
lessonObjectives.l16-where-lines-cross: Read the solution of a pair of equations as the point where their graphs cross.
lessonObjectives.l17-two-baskets: Use simultaneous equations to back out two unknown prices from two basket costs.
